text:
sara: Quick sync — finalizing calibration dataset & prompt set for the multi-quant bakeoff (FP8 / INT8 / GPTQ / AWQ). Goal: 10k probes balanced across long-tail, instruction-following, math, code, and safety prompts. Propose sample plan + vetting checklist below.

sara: sampling command (example):
```bash
python scripts/sample_prompts.py --domains instruction,code,math,chat,safety --n 10000 --seed 42 --out s3://redwood-quant/calib/promptset.csv
```

anil: +1 on 10k. Can we get 2k holdout for regression checks?

marta: I can produce stratified splits by domain. Suggest thresholds: instruction 40%, code 20%, math 15%, chat 15%, safety 10%.

nina: Add adversarial paraphrases and prompt perturbations (typos, rephrases, verbosity). We'll log accuracy delta per perturbation.

anil: Also want to tag prompts that require multi-step reasoning vs single-shot. Different quant methods fail differently there.

sara: Deployment profiles to capture in results: 
- low-latency (p95 <= 100ms)
- cost-optimized (batched runs, e.g., batch_size=16 on T4)
- high-accuracy (no fallback, stricter quality threshold)
Track per-profile accuracy delta + token-cost.

marta: I'll produce CSV schema: id,domain,difficulty,source,canonical_answer,eval_type,tags,seed,notes. Keeping canonical_answer explicit helps automated diffs.

nina: Metric checklist: EM / exact-match for QA, pass@1 for code, execution-based checks where possible, and token-level logprob deltas. We'll compute delta vs FP32 baseline and report 90/95/99 percentiles.

anil: For GPTQ/AWQ, we should capture per-layer calibration stats and activation histograms for first 500 calibration steps — helps explain failure modes.

marta: We'll keep reproducibility metadata: run_id, git_sha, quant_config, random_seeds. Also export sampling logs and prompt variants.

devops-bot: CI job created: `ci/quant-bakeoff/trigger` (runs on merge to `q-experiments`). Artifacts -> s3://redwood-quant/results/${run_id}/

nina: Note on AWQ: it benefits from per-channel calibration on attention. Please include raw activations dump for a small subset (first 200 prompts) to debug calibration maps.

anil: Timeline?

sara: Target kickoff next Tue. Marta to drop CSV by EOD Fri. Nina to add perturbation scripts and activation dump hooks. Anil to wire up metrics dashboard and cost tagging.

marta: on it :thumbsup: I'll push CSV to `s3://redwood-quant/calib/promptsets/` and open a PR with subset samples for review.

nina: dropping perturbation scripts at `s3://redwood-quant/perturbs/` and a short README with apply/rollback commands.

anil: I'll create a dashboard grouped by `deployment_profile` + `quant_method` and add delta charts vs FP32 baseline.

sara: Thanks — after first run let's do a 30m retro to iterate on calibration heuristics (clip ranges, outlier masking, per-layer vs global).

marta: will include small human spot-check set (200 prompts) for manual review of weird failure cases.

nina: One more: include a simple `failure_reason` taxonomy in the output JSON (e.g., hallucination, timeout, truncated-kv, numeric-mismatch). Makes triage faster.

sara: Perfect. If anyone sees blockers ping here or DM.
